as_told.title: Dead binary companion star approaching the Sun, cycle seen in ice cores
as_told.place_text: Solar system / Antarctica and Greenland ice cores

plain: The researcher Matt LaCroix says the Sun has a dead companion star, and that the two circling each other is the "entire reason" for the Great Year, an ancient idea of a long cosmic cycle of ages, and for the times when civilizations have been wiped out and started over. He says NASA has kept this quiet, and he points to the New Science Encyclopedia of 1987. He gives no other source. Elsewhere in the same talk he adds that the cycle shows up in ice cores drilled in Antarctica and Greenland, and that the companion is drawing near now, "we're right in it right now", though there he does not mention NASA. If true, it would mean another reset could be close.
